result.reason: The operative language does not reach the playbook position because it omits the professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, any services warranty period and compliance-with-laws warranty. Although it provides a software conformity warranty, repair/replace/refund remedies and a malicious-code concept, the warranty runs throughout the term rather than using the required 12-month/90-day structure. It also unnecessarily adds title and non-infringement warranties and proposes SLA terms in the comment, expanding beyond the requested warranty changes. The retained disclaimer that correction of documentation nonconformities cannot or will not occur is also awkwardly inconsistent with the express cure remedy.
